newsitem.title: USA: Amtech to buy Alcatel equity in venture.
newsitem.headline: Amtech to buy Alcatel equity in venture.

text.p: Amtech Corp said Thursday it has agreed to buy Alcatel Alsthom's 51 percent equity interest in the companies' Paris-based joint venture, Alcatel Amtech S.A.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed. The deal would make Alcatel Amtech S.A. an Amtech subsidiary.
The transaction is expected to close in late October, Amtech said.
Amtech said its future financial statements will consolidate all European revenues and operating results that it had previously accounted for on a minority equity basis.

"While we are disappointed that Alcatel's larger business picture necessitated a change in the format of our working relationship, we will continue to work with Alcatel Alsthom in areas of mutual interest, and in particular, on achieving further market success in Europe in the rail systems area," said Amtech Chief Executive G. Russell Mortenson.
Amtech said Alcatel will manufacture some Amtech products through late 1997, when production will be transferred.
